get.summary: Resolved permission grants per scope — use to gate admin UI.

post.summary: Sends a reset link by email. Always returns {sent:true}.
Create an organization (you become owner, tournament admin, on the free plan).

get.summary: Organizations you own or belong to.

post.summary: Add a registered user to the org with a role (tournament_admin | scorer | commentator | viewer).

get.summary: Full permission catalog (resource + action) for the role editor grid.
System roles + this org's custom roles, with their permission sets.

post.summary: Create a custom org role with a permission set.

patch.summary: Edit a custom role; permission_ids (when given) replaces the whole set.

get.summary: All role assignments in this org's scope (org / tournament / match grants).

post.summary: Grant a role scoped to the org, a tournament, or a single match.

get.summary: Public pricing (marketing site). No auth required.

post.summary: Switch the org to another plan (trial starts automatically on paid plans).

get.summary: Public tournament list (filter by status / org).
Public tournament detail with groups + teams.

post.summary: Generate DRAFT fixtures for review — nothing is persisted.
Persist reviewed draft fixtures as scheduled matches.

get.summary: Live state snapshot — Redis-first, Postgres fallback (`source` field says which). Prefer the WebSocket feed (/live) for push updates.
Last N ball events (Redis stream) for instant UI hydration.
Live presence: {viewers, scorers} currently connected via WebSocket.
Full scorecard (batting/bowling cards, fall of wickets).

post.summary: Add manual commentary (commentator/scorer).

get.summary: Stats tab: wagon-wheel vectors, partnerships, over-by-over run rate.

put.summary: Set one team's squad: playing XI + 12th man with can_bat/can_bowl toggles.

get.summary: Tournament leaderboards: metric = runs | wickets | mvp | sr | economy

post.summary: Grant a user match-scoped scorer access.

put.summary: Set match officials (umpires, TV umpire, referee, scorer).

post.summary: Substitution: 12th man / concussion / impact player, with bat-bowl eligibility.
Set opening batters + bowler; match goes live. Also used after an innings break.
Score one ball. Returns the new state + any effects (over_complete, innings_complete, match_complete…).
Send in the next batter after a wicket.

delete.summary: Undo the most recent ball (append-only supersede + full replay rebuild).

post.summary: Offline sync: apply queued balls in order; stops at first conflict for client rebase.
Pause play for rain / bad light. Match status → rain_delay.
Resume play, optionally with a DLS/manual revision (reduced overs and/or revised target).
Decide the pending follow-on (Tests): enforce or bat normally.
Create the Super Over tie-breaker child match for a tied match.
Close the current innings manually (declaration, forfeit, rain-shortened).
Finalize: set player of the match, force a result (abandoned/no_result), rebuild stats.
Register an FCM/APNs push token for this device.
